name: About Modal
description: Version and credits dialog. Displays app version, Electron version, Node version, and a clickable 'UseDesign.md' design system link (opens in browser via shell.openExternal). Shows 'The IDE for developers who think spatially' tagline. Closes via 'Close' button, overlay click, or Escape key. Accepts optional onClose callback.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Show modal, register optional close callback
